scenarios.description: Reject forged/mismatched post_crc or unverified staging-to-slot commit when TOOB_TA1_STRICT_NO_CRC_SKIP=1.
With DSLC=0x01 (Production/Deployed) and erased 0xFF WAL sectors, Stage 1 boot_journal_init must fail closed without formatting or booting App.
Replaying a root-signed KDM with sequence_number <= WAL TMR kdm_seq_floor or outdated TCC1 floor must fail closed.
With TOOB_PQC_ENABLED=1 and OTP PQC pubkey SHA-256 hash pinning, an Ed25519-valid envelope carrying an unpinned ML-DSA pubkey must fail closed.
An unsigned App Slot image, a 1-bit tampered TSIG trailer, a revoked key_index, or a tampered Stage 1A image must fail closed before jump_to_vtor_image.
Stage 0 rejects all-0xFF UICR pubkey and halts prior to loading Stage 1 or Guest OS.
